verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or citations specifically describing breadcrumbs, custom tags, or user context APIs in the Sentry SDK — only generic mentions of 'drop in the SDK', fingerprint rules, and unrelated platform/pricing/MCP content. Since verdicts must be judged strictly from the provided evidence, this well-known capability cannot be credited without direct supporting citations.
